items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-09-08
items.q: I played with, like I said, with Dr. B. Sheik.

ctx.x: Well I wanted to ask you about Piku too before I forget it. You say you worked with Piku at one time? You told me before?

Yeah. Yeah. I played several occasions. I played with, like I said, with Dr. B. Sheik. Mm-hmm. And with another occasion I played. Oh! You know who that trumpet plays? Peter LeCobb. And who did he play with? With the, uh, uh, Duncan Oedis. Young Superior. Oh yeah. You know him? Oh yeah, I do. Yeah, that's the one. That's the one. It came to my mind. Peter LeCobb. Mm-hmm. Yeah.

That was the one. And, uh, let's see what we were talking about before. Now, that's good. Big I, Lloyd Piku? Yeah. Well you say you did work with Piku and Peter Locage and Dr. Neltz, uh, Dr. Bache on the record. But Peter Locage played with Dr. Ernest. Oh yeah, he played with Dr. Ernest too. But I knew this band there they were setting up, you know?
